version_name: Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.9 - Short-Recording Speaker Accuracy
release_notes:
# Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.9

Version 4.1.9 improves automatic speaker identification for short interviews, panels, and conversations.

## What changed

- Added a conservative acoustic identity audit for recordings between 30 seconds and 20 minutes.
- Reduces extra speaker identities caused when one established voice is split into a small residual cluster.
- Requires repeated, unanimous acoustic evidence before merging a residual identity.
- Preserves genuinely distinct brief speakers when their voice does not strongly match an established participant.
- Never forces a fixed speaker count in Automatic mode.

## Compatibility and safeguards

- The existing long-recording speaker pipeline and its validated thresholds are unchanged.
- Manual speaker-count selections continue to work as before.
- The correction is fully local and uses the already-decoded audio; no additional network service or model download is required.

This release also includes the interface-language support introduced in 4.1.8.
